items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Andrew White was on this on oboe

ctx.x: You were in that number, and then Andrew White was on this on oboe and Andrew is a story in himself because I know he played with Elvin’s group and Ken and I saw him in Germany. Andrew is a real character.
Well, that’s what some of us are (laughs) and some of us hope that we’re not (laughs).
